item.title: Lawmakers react to Trump nominating Kevin Warsh for Federal Reserve chairman
item.description: President Donald Trump nominated Kevin Warsh as Federal Reserve chair to replace Jerome Powell, sparking mixed reactions from key senators ahead of a contentious confirmation process.

item.title: Who is Kevin Warsh, Trump's pick to succeed Jerome Powell as Fed chair?
item.description: President Donald Trump announced on Friday that he is nominating former Federal Reserve Governor Kevin Warsh to become chairman of the central bank.

item.title: Business leaders celebrate Trump's Fed chair pick
item.description: Business leaders praised Trump's nomination of Kevin Warsh as Federal Reserve chairman, citing his extensive experience and proven crisis management expertise.

item.title: Why California’s housing market remains unaffordable for many Americans
item.description: California's housing crisis deepens as chronic shortages push home prices beyond reach of workers, making it one of America's least affordable states

item.title: Are new cars becoming a luxury item in America?
item.description: New car prices average $48,422 in April 2025, pricing out Americans who turn to used cars as luxury buyers make up 19.2% of new car purchases, according to an industry expert.

item.title: LARRY KUDLOW: Warsh is the right man for the Fed
item.description: Kevin Warsh has a tremendous opportunity to be a transformational figure in Fed history

item.title: Trump picks veteran staffer to head Bureau of Labor Statistics
item.description: President Trump plans to nominate economist Brett Matsumoto to head the Bureau of Labor Statistics, elevating a career staffer who has worked at the agency since 2015.

item.title: Obamacare enrollment fell by more than 1M enrollees for 2026
item.description: Obamacare enrollment projected to drop by over 1 million Americans as health insurance premiums surge following the end of COVID-era federal subsidies in 2026.

item.title: Seahawks to go up for sale after Super Bowl, could see record payday: report
item.description: Paul Allen's estate will reportedly sell the Seattle Seahawks after the Super Bowl, marking a major shift in the NFL franchise’s future ownership.
